0022600024.text: The Nuggets (2-2, 9th in the West) visit the Suns (1-2, 11th in the West) in the fifth game of Denver's season, an Emirates NBA Cup game in West Group A. Denver is on a one-game winning streak, is 1-1 on the road, and sits 1.5 games back in the Northwest, while Phoenix has lost its last game and is 2 games back in the Pacific. Denver is without Alpha Diallo (personal), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) with Oso Ighodaro listed as day-to-day with an oblique strain and a game-time decision; the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Denver won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 125-123 win in Phoenix on March 24, 2026.
